text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut. Though Tamamo Cross 
managed to finish the race safely...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... What's goin' on? My legs... feel 
so unsteady...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is it really this brutal gettin' roughed 
up even in the Junior Class...? No 
power's... swellin' up from my gut...

I decided to let her rest for a bit before 
reviewing today's results and discussing 
our plans for the future.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-It's really no big deal! I'm just a bit 
tired, is all.
choice_data_list:
Could it be because you didn't eat 
properly?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, well... I mean, maybe there's a 
little bit of that, but...
choice_data_list:
But it's right before an important race... 
why...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, well... It's really not that big of 
a deal, but, you know..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't eat that much. It's always 
been that way, ever since I was little..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here, kiddos! You can have Big Sis's food 
too! That wasn't enough for ya, was it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Eh, are you sure, Tama-neene?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Big sis wants to eat too...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm stuffed right now. My neighbor just 
gave me some kasu udon earlier."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why you gotta eat Big Sis's share 
too. If you don't eat well, you won't grow 
big and strong, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I was always lettin' the young'uns eat 
first, so my stomach ended up shrinkin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why not eating much and staying 
focused is my way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Deeply ingrained habits don't change that 
easily. Even if I try to increase how much 
I eat this late in the game...

...She probably tried to eat it, but it 
seems she just can't stomach it.

That said, unless she changes her 
long-standing eating habits, she won't be 
able to build an athlete's body.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Even without food, I've got 
pure Naniwa grit on my side!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"With this grit, I'm heading for a GⅠ 
next! How about the 'Hopeful Stakes'? 
Gotta bring glory back to my hometown as 
soon as possible—"
choice_data_list:
It's fine to aim for it, but setting it as 
a goal is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The heck?! It'll be totally fine! Don't 
be such a buzzkill!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's all about momentum here! 
Don't overcomplicate things, just ride the 
wave!
choice_data_list:
For the sake of your future, shouldn't we 
prioritize building up your body?

For the sake of your future, shouldn't we 
prioritize physical conditioning?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can't be messin' around with trivial 
stuff like that! I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For my family's sake, I'll blow away 
anyone in my way, no matter how big they 
are! I ain't the same me from before my 
debut!
choice_data_list: Wanna test it out tomorrow, then?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh? A test? Bring it on, I'll ace it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buuuooonooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhh?!
(Boing!!)

Grand Sumo Debut Basho: Tamamo Cross was 
defeated via front push out by the grand 
yokozuna, Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Like I can blow that away!
choice_data_list:
Do you want to focus on body conditioning, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Tch, there are huge folks like this 
crawlin' all over the upper tiers, huh? If 
that's the case... I can't get enough of 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Understood. So for now, I'll build up my 
strength and do small-time races, huh. So, 
until when?

I think to myself. Even if we aim to 
improve her physical constitution now, 
results won't appear overnight. In that 
case, the first milestone should be...
choice_data_list:
—Next spring. Right before the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That takes too long! I wanna go straight 
to G1 races...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Bu~no~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh, fine! I get it! Until next 
spring, right? In that case, I'm gonna 
gorge myself until then!

—And so, we decided to carefully select 
our races until next spring.
